Notes - Brightleaf Family Dental

Direct client, no agency involved. Dr. Amara Osei, two locations in the
Harrisburg area, general and cosmetic dentistry. Taking new patients and
that's the whole point of the campaign - new patient acquisition, mainly
families and adults considering cosmetic work (whitening, veneers,
Invisalign).

One budget: $30,000 total for the campaign. That's the number, she was firm
about it.

Straight streaming TV buy. No sports - she said explicitly she doesn't want
to be in live sports, doesn't think it's her patient. Also wants audience
targeting on top of the general streaming to get at the in-market dental
folks.

Geography is the Harrisburg DMA.

Timing: wants to be live for the January new-year push. Start of January
through the end of March.

Measurement: web attribution is what she cares about, wants to see
appointment request form fills. No brand lift.

Open items:
- Creative: she has a spot from two years ago, unclear if it's usable or if
  we're producing something new
- She asked about adding the second location's address as a separate
  creative version, didn't resolve it
